content: Hello! This is Jordan from Horizon Travel. How can I assist you with your travel plans today?
Hi Jordan, I'd like to book a flight to Paris next month.
Great choice! To get started, can I have your full name as it appears on your ID?
Thanks, Michael. Could you please provide the best phone number to reach you for booking confirmations?
Perfect. Lastly, I'll need your email address so we can send your itinerary and tickets.
You can send them to michael.t@example.com.
Thank you for the details. I'll process your booking now and send over the confirmation shortly.
